title: As Streaming Becomes the Main Shelf, CTV Becomes the Holiday Power Play | Elemental TV

facts.fact: Elemental TV's page for its 'As Streaming Becomes the Main Shelf, CTV Becomes the Holiday Power Play' article is dated November 17, 2025.

Elemental TV's teaser for its FIFA World Cup 2026 article cites a recent predictions study built on 1,066 U.S. adult surveys, which the teaser says shows the tournament will be watched differently than any before it.
facts.quote: A recent predictions study, built on 1,066 U.S. adult surveys, makes one thing clear: this tournament will be watched differently than any before it.
